regions.merged_text: God bless you Mrs. George Schulte. We are enrolling your little Thomas in the Seraphic Mass Association. If he be not improving by the time this reaches you, let us trust in God's goodness that the doctors get a good surpris of some kind. In the mean time have as many of your friends as possible offer holy Communions and promise some extra Receptions in thanksgiving if the outlook shortly takes a decidely brighter aspect, etc. We will pray too for your intention, especially in regard to little Thomas.
